```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(colleyRstats)
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

colleyRstats_setup(print_citation = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)

# Everything shown below is read from the pipeline store rather than recomputed,
# so this report cannot disagree with what tar_make() produced. If a chunk errors
# with "target not found", run targets::tar_make() first.
#
# Quarto renders with this file's own directory as the working directory, so the
# store is named explicitly rather than found by search.
root <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "." else ".."
store <- file.path(root, "_targets")

# The pipeline's own design settings (PREDICTORS, CLUSTER).
for (f in list.files(file.path(root, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)

scored <- tar_read(scored, store = store)
results <- tar_read(results, store = store)
plots <- tar_read(plots, store = store)
```

## Design

Instruments: {{instruments}}.

```{r design}
scored |>
  count(across(all_of(PREDICTORS)), name = "observations") |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## What was run

`fit_recommended()` chose a model per outcome from the measurement scale of that
outcome, whether the design is clustered, and whether the parametric assumptions
hold. This is the audit trail for the methods section.

```{r models}
knitr::kable(results$summary)
```

## Descriptives

```{r descriptives}
#| results: asis
outcomes <- results$summary$outcome

for (dv in outcomes) {
  fit <- results$fits[[dv]]
  data <- fit$data
  cat("\n\n### ", dv, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (fit$recommendation$outcome_type %in% c("ordinal", "binary", "nominal") ||
      !is.numeric(data[[dv]])) {
    descriptive <- data |>
      select(all_of(c(PREDICTORS, dv))) |>
      rename(response = all_of(dv)) |>
      count(across(all_of(PREDICTORS)), response, name = "n")
  } else {
    descriptive <- data |>
      group_by(across(all_of(PREDICTORS))) |>
      summarise(
        n = sum(!is.na(.data[[dv]])),
        M = round(mean(.data[[dv]], na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        SD = round(sd(.data[[dv]], na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
  print(knitr::kable(descriptive))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Results

```{r results}
#| results: asis
for (dv in names(results$fits)) {
  fit <- results$fits[[dv]]
  cat("\n\n### ", dv, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(expand_latex_macros(paste(fit$sentences, collapse = " ")), "\n\n")

  if (!is.null(fit$contrasts)) {
    print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(fit$contrasts), digits = 3))
  }
}
```

```{r figures}
}
```
